paper_description: Discovered the first legume protein complex regulating rhizobial infection thread polar growth (infectosome)
Established the first root hair-specific rhizobial infection transcriptome (root hair infectome) in the legume model plant Medicago truncatula
Revealed the first gene regulatory network for rhizobial infection in legumes and uncovered the core regulatory role of key transcription factors in symbiotic nitrogen fixation evolution

The infectome series of research results are ESI highly cited papers, and the discovery of the infectosome is considered to have 'developed a new direction for studying and understanding the mechanism of rhizobial infection thread development'
